scopeBasis.macos: Since v0.8.3 the sync contract requires two new capabilities (folder-enforced-priority-v1, reading-history-order-v1) while the protocol number stays 39; the macOS, Windows, Linux, Android and iPhone hosts require them, so 0.8.3 and 0.8.4 clients cannot synchronize.
